title: addresses.postal_code column renamed to postcode
query: What breaks if the postal_code column of the account-service addresses table is renamed to postcode?

proposed_change.diff:
-    postal_code  text        NOT NULL,
+    postcode     text        NOT NULL,

affected_repositories.name: account-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: V1__identity_schema.sql owns the column; AddressRow, MyBatisAddressRepository, and AddressDtoMapper bind postalCode by constructor and column mapping

notes: Single-repo DB record. No service reads another service's tables, so the blast radius stays inside account-service. The db contract has no cross-repo consumers; it exercises the db type in scoring without crediting phantom consumers.
